# AI chat — bc_ui reference

Components: `BCAIChat`, `BCChatThread`, `BCChatComposer`, `BCChatMarkdown`, `BCAgentStepList`, `BCVoiceOverlay`.

## BCAIChat

A whole AI chat screen: transcript, composer and greeting, over a `BCChatController`. Every slot takes a builder that receives the widget it would otherwise have used, so you wrap rather than rewrite; drop to `BCChatThread` and `BCChatComposer` when even the layout needs to change. It talks to no model — `onSend` hands you the text and the attachments, and you stream the reply back through the controller.

```dart
// Two controllers: one owns the transcript, one owns the draft.
final _chat = BCChatController();
final _composer = BCChatComposerController();

BCAIChat(
  controller: _chat,
  composerController: _composer,
  greeting: 'What can I help with?',
  suggestions: const [
    BCChatSuggestion(label: 'Summarise my inbox'),
    BCChatSuggestion(label: 'Plan the sprint'),
  ],
  onAttachPressed: _pickFiles,      // your picker, your upload
  onVoicePressed: _startVoiceMode,
  onStop: _cancelRequest,
  onSend: (text, attachments) async {
    _chat.add(BCChatMessage(
      id: '${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      role: BCChatRole.user,
      text: text,
      attachments: attachments,
    ));
    _composer.reset();

    // Open the reply, push chunks as they arrive, then close it.
    const replyId = 'reply';
    _chat.add(const BCChatMessage(
      id: replyId,
      role: BCChatRole.assistant,
      status: BCChatMessageStatus.streaming,
    ));
    await for (final chunk in myModel.stream(text)) {
      _chat.appendChunk(replyId, chunk);
    }
    _chat.finish(replyId);
  },
);

// Swap in a different markdown renderer, keep everything else.
BCAIChat(
  controller: _chat,
  onSend: _send,
  contentBuilder: (context, message) => GptMarkdown(message.text),
);
```

### BCChatController

Owns a thread's messages and whether the agent is currently working.  Create one in a `State` and dispose it there: Streaming a reply is three calls — open the message, push chunks as they arrive, close it: `isGenerating` is set for you by `appendChunk` and cleared by `finish` and `fail`, so the composer's send button becomes a stop button on its own.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `messages` |  | `const <BCChatMessage>[]` |  |

### BCChatComposerController

Owns what the composer is holding — the draft text and the attachments staged alongside it.  It wraps a `TextEditingController`. Pass your own if you already have one; otherwise one is created here and disposed with the controller, so the ownership rule is "whoever made it disposes it". You do the file picking. When your picker returns, describe what it gave you with `BCChatAttachment`s and hand them over: then walk `progress` up with `updateAttachment` as your upload reports in.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `textController` |  | — |  |
| `initialText` |  | — |  |
| `attachments` |  | `const <BCChatAttachment>[]` |  |

### BCChatMessage

One turn in the conversation.  Immutable: streaming works by replacing the message with a copy carrying more text, which is what `BCChatController.appendChunk` does for you.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` | required | Stable identity. Every controller method that targets a message matches on this, so it has to be unique within the thread. |
| `role` | `BCChatRole` | required |  |
| `text` | `String` | `''` | The body. Rendered as markdown by default — see `BCChatMarkdown`. |
| `status` | `BCChatMessageStatus` | `BCChatMessageStatus.complete` |  |
| `createdAt` | `DateTime?` | — | Drives the date separators in a `BCChatThread`. Null messages are grouped under whichever separator precedes them. |
| `attachments` | `List<BCChatAttachment>` | `const <BCChatAttachment>[]` |  |
| `steps` | `List<BCAgentStep>` | `const <BCAgentStep>[]` | The agent's tool calls for this turn, shown above `text`. |
| `error` | `String?` | — | Shown in place of the body when `status` is `BCChatMessageStatus.failed`. |
| `metadata` | `Map<String, Object?>?` | — | Anything your app needs to carry along; bc_ui ignores it. |

**`BCChatRole`** — `user`, `assistant`, `system`

**`BCChatMessageStatus`** — `pending`, `streaming`, `complete`, `failed`

### BCChatAttachment

A file riding along with a message.  bc_ui never touches the filesystem: there are no bytes and no path here. You pick the file, you upload it, and you describe the result with one of these. `thumbnail` is any `ImageProvider`, so a memory image, a file image or a network URL all work.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` | required | Stable identity. Removing and updating an attachment both match on this. |
| `name` | `String` | required | The filename shown on the chip. |
| `kind` | `BCChatAttachmentKind` | `BCChatAttachmentKind.other` |  |
| `sizeBytes` | `int?` | — | Size in bytes, rendered as a human-readable subtitle when present. |
| `thumbnail` | `ImageProvider?` | — | Preview image for `BCChatAttachmentKind.image`. Without one the chip falls back to the kind's icon. |
| `status` | `BCChatAttachmentStatus` | `BCChatAttachmentStatus.ready` |  |
| `progress` | `double?` | — | Upload progress 0–1. Null renders an indeterminate bar while `status` is `BCChatAttachmentStatus.uploading`. |
| `error` | `String?` | — | Shown on the chip when `status` is `BCChatAttachmentStatus.failed`. |
| `metadata` | `Map<String, Object?>?` | — | Anything your app needs to carry along; bc_ui ignores it. |

**`BCChatAttachmentKind`** — `image`, `video`, `audio`, `document`, `code`, `archive`, `other`

**`BCChatAttachmentStatus`** — `pending`, `uploading`, `ready`, `failed`

### BCAgentStep

One thing the agent did on the user's behalf — a tool call, a search, a file edit — rendered as a row in a `BCAgentStepList`.  `children` nests one level, for a step that fans out into sub-calls. Deeper nesting renders flat.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` | required | Stable identity, used to keep expansion state across rebuilds. |
| `label` | `String` | required | The headline — "Searched the web", "Edited bc_input.dart". |
| `detail` | `String?` | — | A dimmer second line: the query, the path, the argument. |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | — | Overrides the icon derived from `status`. |
| `status` | `BCAgentStepStatus` | `BCAgentStepStatus.pending` |  |
| `duration` | `Duration?` | — | How long the step took, shown right-aligned once it is set. |
| `output` | `String?` | — | Tool output, rendered in a monospace pane when the step is expanded. |
| `children` | `List<BCAgentStep>` | `const <BCAgentStep>[]` |  |

**`BCAgentStepStatus`** — `pending`, `running`, `success`, `error`, `skipped`

## BCChatThread

The scrolling transcript. It follows the bottom while you are reading the newest message and stops the moment you scroll up, so a streaming reply never yanks the view away; a pill takes you back. Renders bubbles, date separators, agent steps and attachments.

```dart
// The transcript on its own, with your own composer underneath.
Column(
  children: [
    Expanded(
      child: BCChatThread(
        controller: _chat,
        variant: BCChatBubbleVariant.surface,
        avatarBuilder: (context, message) =>
            message.role == BCChatRole.assistant
                ? BCAvatar.withInitials('AI', size: BCAvatarSize.small)
                : null,
        actionsBuilder: (context, message) => [
          BCChatMessageAction(
            icon: Icons.copy_rounded,
            label: 'Copy',
            onPressed: () => Clipboard.setData(
              ClipboardData(text: message.text),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ),
    MyOwnComposer(),
  ],
);
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | `BCChatController?` | — | The thread's state. Either this or `messages` must be set. |
| `messages` | `List<BCChatMessage>?` | — | A plain list, for when the state lives in your own store. Ignored when `controller` is set. |
| `scrollController` | `ScrollController?` | — | Pass your own to drive the scroll position from outside. One is created and disposed here otherwise. |
| `variant` | `BCChatBubbleVariant` | `BCChatBubbleVariant.plain` | How assistant messages are drawn. |
| `messageBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, BCChatMessage, Widget)?` | — | Wraps or replaces a whole message row. |
| `contentBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, BCChatMessage)?` | — | Replaces the markdown body of a message. |
| `attachmentBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, BCChatAttachment, Widget)?` | — | Wraps or replaces each attachment chip. |
| `stepBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, BCAgentStep, Widget)?` | — | Wraps or replaces each agent-step tile. |
| `avatarBuilder` | `Widget? Function(BuildContext, BCChatMessage)?` | — | The avatar for a message. Return null for no avatar — the default. |
| `dateSeparatorBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, DateTime)?` | — | Replaces the default centred date chip. |
| `emptyBuilder` | `WidgetBuilder?` | — | What to show on an empty thread. |
| `header` | `Widget?` | — | Pinned above the first message — a model picker, a system notice. |
| `footer` | `Widget?` | — | Pinned below the last message. |
| `actionsBuilder` | `List<BCChatMessageAction> Function(BuildContext, BCChatMessage)?` | — | The actions offered on a message. Return an empty list for none. |
| `onLinkTap` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | — |  |
| `onMessageLongPress` | `void Function(BCChatMessage)?` | — |  |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry?` | — | Overrides the default `EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12)`. |
| `messageSpacing` | `double` | `BCSpacing.md` |  |
| `showScrollShadow` | `bool` | `true` | Fades content out under the top edge. Needs a flat background behind the list, since the shadow is a solid-to-transparent gradient. |
| `showJumpToBottom` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `autoScrollThreshold` | `double` | `80` | How close to the bottom the user has to be for new content to keep scrolling into view. |
| `showDateSeparators` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `typingLabel` | `String?` | — | Text beside the typing dots. |
| `maxWidthFactor` | `double?` | — | Forwarded to each bubble. |
| `reduceMotion` | `bool?` | — | Overrides `MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf`. |

### BCChatBubble

The container a message's content sits in.  This draws the fill, the asymmetric corners and the width cap, and nothing else — it takes any `child`, so it is equally the right box for text, an image grid, or a rich card of your own.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `child` | `Widget` | required |  |
| `role` | `BCChatRole` | `BCChatRole.assistant` |  |
| `variant` | `BCChatBubbleVariant` | `BCChatBubbleVariant.plain` | How an assistant message is drawn. Ignored for the other roles, which are always filled. |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color?` | — | Overrides the fill derived from `role` and `variant`. |
| `shape` | `ShapeBorder?` | — | Overrides the default asymmetric continuous shape. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry?` | — | Overrides the default `EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10)` — or `EdgeInsets.zero` for a plain assistant message, which is unboxed. |
| `maxWidthFactor` | `double?` | — | Fraction of the available width the bubble may occupy. Overrides the default 0.78. A plain assistant message ignores this and takes the full measure. |
| `alignment` | `AlignmentGeometry?` | — | Overrides the side the bubble is pinned to, which otherwise follows `role`. |

**`BCChatRole`** — `user`, `assistant`, `system`

**`BCChatBubbleVariant`** — `plain`, `surface`

The row of actions under a message.  On a device with a mouse these fade in on hover; on touch they are always visible, because there is nothing to hover with.

| `actions` | `List<BCChatMessageAction>` | required |  |

## BCChatComposer

The input row: a draft that grows to `maxLines` and then scrolls, staged attachment chips, and a send button that becomes a stop button while the agent works. Enter sends on desktop and inserts a newline on phones, or set `submitBehavior` yourself. bc_ui does no file picking — wire `onAttachPressed` to your own.

```dart
BCChatComposer(
  controller: _composer,
  isGenerating: _chat.isGenerating,
  onSend: (text, attachments) => _send(text, attachments),
  onStop: _cancelRequest,
  onAttachPressed: () async {
    final picked = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles();
    _composer.addAttachments([
      for (final file in picked?.files ?? [])
        BCChatAttachment(
          id: file.path!,
          name: file.name,
          kind: BCChatAttachmentKind.document,
          sizeBytes: file.size,
          status: BCChatAttachmentStatus.uploading,
          progress: 0,
        ),
    ]);
    // Walk `progress` up as your upload reports in, then mark it ready —
    // send stays disabled until it is.
  },
);

// Desktop drag-and-drop: bring your own plugin, bc_ui draws the target.
BCChatDropTarget(
  isActive: _dragging,
  child: BCChatComposer(controller: _composer, onSend: _send),
);
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | `BCChatComposerController` | required | Owns the draft text and the staged attachments. |
| `onSend` | `void Function(String text, List<BCChatAttachment> attachments)` | required | Called with the trimmed draft when the user sends. The composer does not clear itself — call `BCChatComposerController.reset` once you have taken the text, so a failed send can leave the draft in place. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | — |  |
| `layout` | `BCChatComposerLayout` | `BCChatComposerLayout.inline` |  |
| `submitBehavior` | `BCChatSubmitBehavior?` | — | Overrides the per-platform default: `BCChatSubmitBehavior.enter` on desktop and web, `BCChatSubmitBehavior.buttonOnly` on phones and tablets, where Enter has to stay a newline. |
| `placeholder` | `String` | `'Ask anything'` |  |
| `isGenerating` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the agent is mid-turn. Swaps send for stop. |
| `isDisabled` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `onStop` | `VoidCallback?` | — | Called when the stop button is pressed. The stop button only appears when this is set and `isGenerating` is true. |
| `onAttachPressed` | `VoidCallback?` | — | Called when the attach button is pressed. The button only appears when this is set. |
| `onVoicePressed` | `VoidCallback?` | — | Called when the mic button is pressed. The button only appears when this is set. |
| `onContentInserted` | `ValueChanged<KeyboardInsertedContent>?` | — | Called when the keyboard or clipboard inserts an image. Android only — see `BCInput.contentInsertionConfiguration`. |
| `onAttachmentRemoved` | `ValueChanged<BCChatAttachment>?` | — | Called when an attachment's remove badge is tapped. Defaults to removing it from `controller`. |
| `attachmentBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, BCChatAttachment, Widget)?` | — | Wraps or replaces each staged attachment chip. |
| `leading` | `List<Widget>` | `const <Widget>[]` | Extra buttons before the attach button. |
| `trailing` | `List<Widget>` | `const <Widget>[]` | Extra buttons after the mic button, before send. |
| `maxLines` | `int` | `6` | How many lines the draft grows to before it starts scrolling instead. Overrides the default 6. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry?` | — | Overrides the default `EdgeInsets.all(8)` inside the composer surface. |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color?` | — | Overrides the default `bc.field`. |
| `borderRadius` | `double?` | — | Overrides the default `BCRadius.xxl`. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` |  |

**`BCChatComposerLayout`** — `inline`, `stacked`

**`BCChatSubmitBehavior`** — `enter`, `modifierEnter`, `buttonOnly`

### BCChatAttachmentChip

One staged or sent file.  Images render as a square thumbnail tile; everything else renders as an icon-and-name row. While the attachment is uploading a progress bar runs along the bottom, and a failure turns the border red and swaps the subtitle for the error.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attachment` | `BCChatAttachment` | required |  |
| `onRemove` | `ValueChanged<BCChatAttachment>?` | — | Shows the remove badge when set. Leave it null on a sent message, where there is nothing left to remove. |
| `onPressed` | `ValueChanged<BCChatAttachment>?` | — | Tap-through, for opening a preview. |
| `size` | `double` | `56` | Edge length of an image tile, and the height of a file row. Overrides the default 56. |
| `fileWidth` | `double` | `220` | Width of a non-image chip. Overrides the default 220. |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color?` | — | Overrides the default `bc.surfaceSecondary`. |
| `borderRadius` | `double?` | — | Overrides the default `BCRadius.xl`. |

### BCChatDropTarget

A drop affordance for the composer: a dashed accent border and a label that fade in while a drag is over it.  Flutter has no built-in desktop file drop, and bc_ui takes no dependency to add one. You wire up whatever drag plugin you use — `super_drag_and_drop`, `desktop_drop` — and drive `isActive` from its hover callbacks; this only draws the state.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `isActive` | `bool` | required | Whether a drag is currently over the target. |
| `child` | `Widget` | required |  |
| `label` | `String` | `'Drop files to attach'` | Text shown over the child while `isActive`. Ignored when `overlay` is set. |
| `overlay` | `Widget?` | — | Replaces the whole default overlay. |
| `borderRadius` | `double?` | — | Overrides the default `BCRadius.xxl`. |

| `suggestions` | `List<BCChatSuggestion>` | required |  |
| `onSelected` | `ValueChanged<BCChatSuggestion>` | required |  |
| `variant` | `BCChipVariant` | `BCChipVariant.secondary` |  |
| `size` | `BCChipSize` | `BCChipSize.md` |  |
| `alignment` | `WrapAlignment` | `WrapAlignment.center` |  |
| `spacing` | `double` | `BCSpacing.sm` |  |
| `runSpacing` | `double` | `BCSpacing.sm` |  |

**`BCChipVariant`** — `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `soft`

**`BCChipSize`** — `sm`, `md`, `lg`

### BCChatSuggestion

One starter prompt offered on an empty thread.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | required | What the user reads on the pill. |
| `prompt` | `String?` | — | What to actually send. Defaults to `label` — set it when the pill reads as a short title but should expand into a fuller prompt. |
| `icon` | `Widget?` | — | Optional leading icon. |

## BCChatMarkdown

The markdown an assistant actually emits — bold, italic, inline code, links, fenced code blocks, lists, quotes, rules and pipe tables — with no third-party dependency. Built for streaming: an unclosed fence renders what has arrived, and an unbalanced `**` stays literal instead of swallowing the rest of the message.

```dart
BCChatMarkdown(
  data: message.text,
  onLinkTap: (href) => launchUrlString(href),
  onCodeCopied: () => BCToast.show(
    context,
    const BCToastData(title: 'Copied', variant: BCToastVariant.success),
  ),
);
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `String` | required |  |
| `textStyle` | `TextStyle?` | — | Overrides the default `BCTypography.textBase`. |
| `color` | `Color?` | — | Overrides the default `bc.foreground` for body text. |
| `onLinkTap` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | — | Called with the href when a link is tapped. Links render as plain coloured text when this is null — bc_ui does not open URLs itself. |
| `selectable` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the text can be selected. Turn it off inside a list that already hosts its own `SelectionArea`. |
| `blockSpacing` | `double` | `BCSpacing.sm` | Gap between blocks. Overrides the default 8. |
| `showCodeCopyButton` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `onCodeCopied` | `VoidCallback?` | — | Forwarded to every `BCChatCodeBlock.onCopy` — raise your toast here. |

### BCChatCodeBlock

A fenced code block with a language label and a copy button.  Long lines scroll horizontally rather than wrapping, because wrapped code is unreadable. No syntax highlighting: `language` is displayed, not tokenized.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | `String` | required |  |
| `language` | `String?` | — | The info string after the opening fence, shown in the header. |
| `showCopyButton` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `onCopy` | `VoidCallback?` | — | Called after the code reaches the clipboard — raise your own toast here. |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color?` | — | Overrides the default `bc.surfaceSecondary` fill. |
| `textStyle` | `TextStyle?` | — | Overrides the default monospace style. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry?` | — | Overrides the default `EdgeInsets.all(12)` around the code itself. |

## BCAgentStepList

The agent's tool calls for one turn, shown above the reply. Collapsed it is a summary row — *Worked for 12s · 4 steps* — that expands into the list; it opens itself while anything is still running so the work is visible as it happens.

```dart
// Steps live on the message, so they render above its reply.
_chat.updateSteps(replyId, const [
  BCAgentStep(
    id: 's1',
    label: 'Searched the web',
    detail: 'flutter chat ui',
    status: BCAgentStepStatus.success,
    duration: Duration(milliseconds: 820),
    output: 'pub.dev/packages/bc_ui',
  ),
  BCAgentStep(
    id: 's2',
    label: 'Reading results',
    status: BCAgentStepStatus.running,
  ),
]);
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | `List<BCAgentStep>` | required |  |
| `initiallyExpanded` | `bool?` | — | Overrides the default, which is "expanded while any step is running". |
| `collapsible` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the summary row can fold the list away. False pins it open and hides the summary. |
| `summaryBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, bool isExpanded, VoidCallback toggle)?` | — | Replaces the default summary row. Receives whether the list is expanded and a callback that toggles it. |
| `tileBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, BCAgentStep, Widget)?` | — | Wraps or replaces each tile. |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color?` | — | Overrides the default `bc.surfaceSecondary`. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry?` | — | Overrides the default `EdgeInsets.all(10)`. |
| `reduceMotion` | `bool?` | — | Overrides `MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf`. |

### BCAgentStepTile

One row in a `BCAgentStepList`.  Tapping it reveals the step's `BCAgentStep.output`. A step with neither output nor children is not tappable, since there would be nothing to show.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `step` | `BCAgentStep` | required |  |
| `depth` | `int` | `0` | Indent level. Nesting beyond one level renders flat. |
| `reduceMotion` | `bool` | `false` |  |

## BCVoiceOverlay

Full-screen voice mode: a breathing orb that swells with the input level, the live transcript, and mute/keyboard/end controls. Purely visual — bc_ui opens no microphone, recognises no speech and requests no permission; you drive `BCVoiceController` from your own audio stack.

```dart
final _voice = BCVoiceController();

// bc_ui draws the session; the microphone is yours.
await BCVoiceOverlay.show(
  context,
  controller: _voice,
  title: 'Assistant',
  onKeyboard: () {},        // back to typing
  onEnd: _recorder.stop,
);

// Somewhere in your audio stack:
_voice.state = BCVoiceState.listening;
_levels = _recorder.onAmplitude.listen((a) {
  _voice.amplitude = a.current;   // 0..1, clamped for you
});
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | `BCVoiceController` | required |  |
| `onEnd` | `VoidCallback?` | — | Ends the session. The default pops the route. |
| `onKeyboard` | `VoidCallback?` | — | Returns to the text composer. The button is hidden when this is null. |
| `onMuteToggle` | `VoidCallback?` | — | Overrides the default, which toggles `BCVoiceController.isMuted`. |
| `title` | `String?` | — | Optional heading above the orb — a model name, an agent name. |
| `orbSize` | `double` | `180` |  |
| `showWaveform` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `showTranscript` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `stateLabelBuilder` | `String Function(BCVoiceState)?` | — | Replaces the default state caption ("Listening", "Thinking"…). |
| `visualizerBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, BCVoiceController)?` | — | Replaces the orb entirely. |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color?` | — | Overrides the default `bc.background`. |
| `reduceMotion` | `bool?` | — | Overrides `MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf`. |

**`BCVoiceState`** — `idle`, `connecting`, `listening`, `thinking`, `speaking`, `error`

### BCVoiceController

Drives the voice UI: the orb's motion, the waveform's bars, the state label and the live transcript.  bc_ui captures no audio and recognises no speech — there is no microphone plugin behind this and no permission is requested. You run whatever audio stack you like and push what it reports in here; the widgets only draw it. `amplitude` is expected at roughly 30–60Hz; the waveform smooths it, so there is no need to filter it yourself first.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` |  | `BCVoiceState.idle` |  |
| `transcript` |  | `''` |  |
| `isMuted` |  | `false` |  |

### BCVoiceOrb

The breathing blob at the centre of voice mode.  It idles with a slow breath, swells with `BCVoiceController.amplitude` while listening, rotates while thinking and pulses faster while speaking. Painted, not animated with widgets, so it stays cheap at 60fps.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | `BCVoiceController` | required |  |
| `size` | `double` | `180` | Diameter of the orb's resting circle. Overrides the default 180. |
| `color` | `Color?` | — | Overrides the colour derived from `BCVoiceController.state`. |
| `reduceMotion` | `bool?` | — | Overrides `MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf`. |

### BCVoiceWaveform

A bar-graph level meter fed by `BCVoiceController.amplitude`.  It keeps its own short history, so the bars scroll rather than all moving together.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | `BCVoiceController` | required |  |
| `barCount` | `int` | `32` |  |
| `height` | `double` | `44` |  |
| `barWidth` | `double` | `3` |  |
| `spacing` | `double` | `3` |  |
| `color` | `Color?` | — | Overrides the default `bc.accent`. |

### BCMicButton

The composer's inline microphone, pulsing while the session listens.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | `BCVoiceController?` | — | Drives the listening pulse. Without one the button is a plain icon. |
| `onPressed` | `VoidCallback?` | — |  |
| `size` | `double` | `32` |  |
| `color` | `Color?` | — | Overrides the default `bc.foreground`. |
